layer1.name: DockNote
layer1.one_liner: Maintenance logbooks for small marina operators.
layer1.description: Digital maintenance logs and inspection reminders for marinas under 200 berths. Desk research looked encouraging on reach; the conversations did not.
layer1.outcome_note: Synthetic fixture. Not a real company and not counted toward separation statistics.

layer2.pins: Pre-registered arithmetic beats accumulated evidence. Three supporting company-page claims say the channel exists; five primary conversations say it does not work, the sample size is met, and the criterion resolves refuted. Support must pin to 10 and ignore the desk claims entirely. This is what stops a founder's optimistic desk research from diluting an answer they already went and got — the whole reason the threshold is fixed at creation time rather than written after the interviews.

assumptions.statement: At least 3 in 10 marina operators under 200 berths reply to outreach through the boating association directory within two weeks

falsification_criterion.applies_to: marina operators under 200 berths listed in the boating association directory
falsification_criterion.observation: contact listed operators and count replies within two weeks

assumptions.statement: At least 5 in 10 marina operators under 200 berths have failed an inspection item in the past two years

falsification_criterion.observation: ask them to recall their last inspection outcome
falsification_criterion.metric: count with a failed item in two years
